start_contact and grown_to_n when it grew: perceive again, the scene is not as it was perceived), pushed = the hand itself pushed the bound object (it moved while the hand touched it: diagnostics.displacement_m, force_n, where pads | hand), lost = the bound object is gone from where the camera sees it (detect_objects again and bind the id it lists with jev_modify bindings, or jev_stop), body = the robot's body moved so far that the motion's goal no longer lies where the arm's rows go and re-planning from here did not take it (diagnostics.moved_m, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, goal_row_error_m, goal_shortfall_m), off_goal = the jaws did not close: the hand stands off the object's grasp point (diagnostics.error_m, error_hand_m), blocked = the object stopped the hand before the grasp (diagnostics.part, force_n, pad_above_top_m), stalled = the hand stayed stopped behind its plan and the arm now holds where it stands, its push released (diagnostics.tracking_error_m, since_s, contact, goal_shortfall_m). The pose is held until your next command.
